Results.ReviewText: This Q 1200 grill replaced another top name brand portable propane grill that I used for 4 years. The Weber is superior in all ways - it cooks more uniformly, has better temperature control and is easier to clean. I couldn't be more pleased with it.
Results.Title: Best grill yet

Results.ReviewText: A pretty good little grill.  It heats up in a reasonable amount of time.  Propane canisters are easy to attach.  Happy with my purchase.
Results.Title: I like

Results.ReviewText: A well made, durable portable grill as expected from a Weber product.  This grill is great for camping, tailgating or anyplace you want to take and use a grill.  Hope
Results.Title: Fantastic Portable Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great beach grill, temp surpassed 500 degrees. Cooked burgers and hot dogs quickly. Clean up was a breeze when I got home and the grill was cool. I like it so much that I bought my step-daughter one for her patio/beach use.
Results.Title: Great little beach grill

Results.ReviewText: Wonderful size and design espevcially for use in RV.  Small enough to store away yet large enough cooking area for our small family.  I also like the aluminum disposable juice catcher on the bottom.  My only complaint, it is difficult for it to light up with significant wind outside.
Results.Title: Especially for our Camper RV

Results.ReviewText: While it cooks like a Weber should, it gets four stars for a design flaw. It's supposed to be a portable grill but - you can barely grab right side handle because the regulator where the gas bottle screws in is in the way. Serious design flaw as the grill is NOT light. I'm not sure how this made it past prototype. It's a great handle and the left side is solid and comfortable to hold but there is no way to get a good solid grip on the right side. We bought it as a coach grill and it will serve that purpose well as there isn't a need to move it around once set up. It cooks well, we've done burgers and chicken on it and look forward to years of use.
Results.Title: Cooks like a Weber, four stars for a design flaw.

Results.ReviewText:
Portable, heats fast, cooks perfectly 
Only negative is the relative size when cooking for a party
Results.Title: Review

Results.ReviewText: I have used it several times. Food tastes great. Would definitely recommend it to anyone
Results.Title: Great job works great

Results.ReviewText: Great size, easy to assemble, and perfectly sized cooking surface.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: This is an excellent grill. I just bought my second one after about 5-6 years of heavy usage. It cooks hot enough - 400 degrees plus - for a good steak!
Results.Title: Superb

Results.ReviewText: For smaller grilled lunches or dinners the Weber Q1200 is perfect! It heats very quickly, the porcelain-enameled cast iron grill grates are top quality, leave nice grill marks and are easy to clean. The pull out grease tray is also a nice added easy-clean feature. The fold out trays are useful. What I like most is the 8.500 BTU output power and smooth flame control. This grill can cook anything and the size is just right for a small family.
Results.Title: Perfect Small Grill

Results.ReviewText: Second Weber 1200 grill. Gave my first one to my son and bought a second. Absolutely love these grills. It meets our needs as a primary grill and a portable. I bring it to concerts, ski outings, beach, back of the boat, etc. Can use the small tanks or an adapter for larger tanks. Keep in mind the small tanks are easily refilled from a larger tank using an adapter - always have a backup.  The grill burns more evenly than any other I’ve owned. Highly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Best for my needs. Use it year round. In all kinds of weather
Results.Title: Retired

Results.ReviewText: Great grill i bought for camping but found i use it through out the week.
Results.Title: Awesome grill that is easy to use!

Results.Title: Great little grill!

Results.ReviewText: It is winter so I havent used it but I built a table and got it set up ready for the summer. It is the perfect size for me and I can take it inside during the winter and store it easily. It looks like it will be easy to clean and I cannot wait to try it out.
Results.Title: Weber Portable Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this as a portable tabletop grill. Shocked at the quality of teh cast iron, grates, design of the grill.  Cooked steaks perfectly.
Results.Title: Fantastic legit grill

Results.ReviewText: Great little gas grill for my pontoon boat! I don't know why Weber hasn't addressed the marine market and left it to a crappy mfr.
Results.Title: Backpacker

Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Reçu en cadeau et très content de ce petit BBQ qui accompagne à merveille mon MasterTouch.

Results.ReviewText: I bought the same grill many years ago and used it exclusively for camping. I basically wore it out with hundreds of wonderful meals. I was so satisfied with it that I decided to purchase another one exactly the same. It may be a little more expensive than others but overall well worth it. I definitely recommend it.
Results.Title: Excellent grill

Results.ReviewText: This was a gift for my son. They take it up when they go snowboarding at Mt. baker and love it!
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200

Results.ReviewText: We used a Weber 1200Q last year for 3 months at a 1BR condo we rented in Puerto Vallarta, MX. We are renting a 2BR this year for 3 months so I purchased my own grill at the Weber store just north of Puerto Vallarta. We are moving to a 4BR condo next year and even though this new condo has a large grill, I’m sure we’ll use the Weber Grill there most times too!
Results.Title: Loving our Weber in Mexico

Results.ReviewText: My Weber grill is easy to cook on.  The temperature control makes is easy to keep the grill at the right temperature to cook chicken, hamburgers, ribs and vegetables.
Results.Title: Cooking on the grill
